advisory.summary: Measured per-head amplification includes LayerNorm effect (LN+head, not head alone). Correct for real-forward-pass measurement but worth noting in results interpretation.
Single FFN compression seed per block. Acceptable for structural census; if borderline, re-run with 3 seeds.

summary: Clean analysis plan. Per-head amplification is the right metric (functional, not representational). Thresholds well-separated from uniform null (25% top-3 vs 70% confirmed). LN is part of measured function, not a confound. No fitting or detection thresholds involved. Two advisories: LN included in measurement (desired), single compression seed (acceptable for census).
